_comment: PLAY ability: banish top card of deck, if blue (pitch 3) create Runechant. BANISH from TOP_DECK banishes the top card of the controller's deck and stores it in ref 'banished'. CONDITIONAL_EFFECT checks REF_PITCH_IS with pitch 3 (blue) on the banished card; if true, creates a Runechant token. GoAgain in printed_keywords fires from card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored. Pitch 3 confirmed from card data (blue printing). The token slug 'runechant' must exist in json/tokens/ for this to work at runtime.
